name: eGPU Indicator
description:
Status, usage and safe eject for an NVIDIA eGPU on a USB4 / Thunderbolt laptop.

The indicator appears only while an eGPU is plugged in: PCIe link, temperature, load, VRAM, power, programs using the GPU, and one-click eject before unplugging.

Eject needs the companion toolkit (amd-usb4-egpu-toolkit), whose setup script installs the root-owned helper run through pkexec.
